We thoroughly evaluate the models' capabilities in three aspects: (1) full-text translation, which means the translation quality of all the text in the image -BLEU and COMET. (2) plain-text translation, which means the translation quality of the text after removing formulas and tables -BLEU-PT. (3) structure preserving, which means the model's ability to restore the layout structure of the document images -STEDS (Structure Tree-Edit-Distance-based Similarity).
